## Evidence labels

Every claim carries one of these labels. The original keeps them up to date.

| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Observed** | Seen in captured traffic or USB descriptors. From captures of the official editor's traffic in the GE150PRO repository. |
| **Static** | Read from the editor binary: disassembly (`otool`), symbol names (`nm`), or embedded Qt resources. |
| **Verified** | Observed *and* reproduced by the web app against the real device (user confirmed behavior). |
| **Inferred** | Consistent with the evidence, not directly proven. Treat as a hypothesis. |
| **Unknown** | Not determined. Listed under [Gaps](#gaps). |

## Quick reference

```
USB HID, VID 0x0483 PID 0x5703, interface 5, 64-byte reports, no report IDs
report  = [n] [n bytes of stream] [padding]           n <= 63
message = AA 55 | len_lo len_hi | cmd | payload | crc_hi crc_lo
len     = 1 + payload length
crc     = CRC-16/GSM (poly 0x1021, init 0, no reflection, xorout 0xFFFF) over len_lo..payload, big-endian
values  = uint16 little-endian unless stated
H->D command = D->H command | 0x80 for module/preset families (0x02<->0x82, 0x16<->0x96, 0x34<->0xB4)
```

| Cmd | Dir | Purpose | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `31` / `32`,`12`,`11` | H→D / D→H | request / report system settings, spill-over, global EQ (`RequestDeviceSystemData`) | Verified (reports), Static (pairing) |
| `A0` / `20` | H→D / D→H | request / dump all 200 presets | Verified |
| `C1` / `41` | H→D / D→H | request / report user IR / amp-capture slot names (`RequestIrAmpName`) | Static (name), Observed (traffic) |
| `8C` / `0C` | H→D / D→H | request / report drum machine state (`RequestRhythmData`) | Static (name), Observed (report) |
| `B0` / `30`,`33`,`18`,`02`–`0A` | H→D / D→H | request current state (stored copy + live reports); answered at any time | Verified (self-test) |
| `96` / `16` | H→D / D→H | select preset / preset changed on pedal | Verified |
| `82`–`8A` / `02`–`0A` | H→D / D→H | set / report one effect module (real time) | Verified both directions |
| `97` | H→D | rename preset | Observed |
| `C3` / `43` | H→D / D→H | store full preset / ack | Observed |
| `B4` / `34` | H→D / D→H | UI focus (which page/control is active) | Observed, id map partial |
| `A4`–`A8` / `24`–`28` | H→D / D→H | input level, brightness, cab outs, OTG level, language | H→D Observed; Verified both directions |

## Transport

| Item | Value | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| USB VID/PID | `0x0483` / `0x5703`, product string "GE150Pro", manufacturer "NXP SEMICONDUCTORS", bcdDevice 2.00 | Observed (`ioreg`) |
| Interfaces | 0–4 USB Audio Class (the pedal is also a USB audio interface); 5 HID | Observed |
| HID interface | #5, usage page 1 (Generic Desktop), usage 0 | Observed |
| Report descriptor | `05010900a101150025ff19012908954075088102190129089102c0` → 64-byte input report, 64-byte output report, no report IDs, no feature reports | Observed |
| Editor writes | always 64 bytes via HIDAPI `hid_write`; the first byte is the chunk length (never 0), so on macOS the whole 64 bytes are the report payload | Observed + Static |
| WebHID | `device.sendReport(0, <64 bytes>)`; `inputreport` events deliver 64 bytes | Verified |
| Exclusivity | Only one program can use the HID interface at a time in practice (official editor *or* one browser tab) | Verified |
| Bulk endpoints | The editor also links libusb and has `SendBulkCmd`/`BULK_Write`. No bulk traffic appeared in any capture. | Static; use unknown |

### Report chunking

A report is `[n][n bytes of message stream][padding]`. Long messages continue in the next report
with its own `n` (`0x3F` = 63 for full chunks). The padding is **not zeroed** by the editor or the
device: it contains stale bytes from earlier reports. Always ignore bytes after `n`. *Observed.*

A message starts with `AA 55`. A receiver should reset its buffer when a chunk starts with `AA 55`,
then wait until `len + 6` bytes are buffered. Example: a stored preset (`C3`) is 252 bytes = 4 × 63.

### Message and checksum

```
offset 0  AA
offset 1  55
offset 2  len_lo     len = 1 + payload length
offset 3  len_hi
offset 4  cmd
offset 5  payload (len - 1 bytes)
then      crc_hi crc_lo
```

CRC-16 with polynomial `0x1021`, initial value `0x0000`, input and output not reflected, final XOR
`0xFFFF` (catalogue name CRC-16/GSM), over `len_lo len_hi cmd payload`, appended big-endian.
*Static* (`usbReceiveThread::SendHidCmd` at `0x10001b590`, lookup table at `0x1000fffa0`) and
*Observed* (84 of 84 captured messages verify). The device uses the same framing and CRC. *Observed.*

Worked example, select preset 2 (1B): `AA 55 02 00 96 02 80 98`, sent as report
`08 AA 55 02 00 96 02 80 98 00 … 00`.

## Session start

The web app replays the editor's exact sequence. *Verified.*

| Step | Host sends | Device answers |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `31 01` | `32` system settings, `12` spill-over, `11` global EQ. Answered only here: the same request later in the session gets no reply (*Observed* 2026-11-13). |
| 2 | `A0 01` | 200 × `20`, one per preset, in index order |
| 3 | `C1 01` | `4D` (40 zero bytes, meaning unknown) and `41`: 640 bytes = 20 × 32-byte NUL-padded names, all "EMPTY" on the test unit: user IR / amp-capture slot names (manual: CAB slots 27–36 hold user IRs) |
| 4 | `8C 01` | `0C` drum machine state |
| 5 | `B0 01` | `30` current preset (stored copy), `33`, `18`, then module reports `02`–`0A` with the **live** state including unsaved edits |

The request names are the editor's `usbReceiveThread::RequestDeviceSystemData`, `RequestAllPresetData`,
`RequestIrAmpName`, `RequestRhythmData` and `RequestCurrentPresetData`; each builds its message with
the command byte shown. *Static.* The answers interleave because the editor does not wait between
sends, so the request→answer pairing is from those names plus the timing in captures.

The device answers steps 1–2 while later requests are already queued; the editor does not wait
between sends.

## Presets

200 presets, banks 1–50 × A–D. Index is 1-based: `index = (bank − 1) × 4 + letter + 1`, A=0 … D=3,
so 1A=1, 1B=2, 2A=5, 50D=200. *Observed (1B→2, 2A→5).*

| Cmd | Dir | Payload | Meaning | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `96` | H→D | `index` (1 byte) | select preset. The device does **not** echo the preset data; the host uses its copy from the dump. | Verified |
| `16` | D→H | `index` | preset changed on the pedal (footswitch). Followed by `18` and `33`. | Verified |
| `20` | D→H | preset body (245 bytes) | one preset in the `A0` dump | Verified |
| `30` | D→H | `index`, `focus`, then body bytes 17–244 (228 bytes) | current preset: the **stored** copy (same as the dump entry), not unsaved edits. `focus` is the page the pedal shows, same ids as `34`. | Observed; `focus` Inferred (2026-11-13: `0B` while the pedal showed the EQ page after the last `34 0B`; earlier 5, 6) |
| `97` | H→D | `index`, name[16] | rename. The editor sends it before and after a store. | Observed |
| `C3` | H→D | preset body (245 bytes) | store a complete preset to slot `index` (persists) | Observed |
| `43` | D→H | `index` | store acknowledged | Observed |

### Preset body (245 bytes)

| Offset | Size | Field | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | index, 1-based | Observed |
| 1 | 16 | name, ASCII, NUL-padded, max 16 chars | Observed |
| 17 | 9 × 24 | modules in slot order (see below) | Observed, cross-checked |
| 233 | 12 | `MODULE_CTRL, PARA_CTRL, FUN_SWITCH, VOL_SWITCH, VOL_MIN, VOL_MAX` (uint16 each) | Inferred: values equal the `.mo` `Exp` block of the same preset |

Cross-check: decoding the 200-preset dump and comparing with the 200 `.mo` files of the same name
matches 1719 of 1728 module slots exactly (values at their catalog positions, see below). The 9 others
are presets 14 "Ultra Clean" and 154 "Pop Drive", whose modules on the test unit are different models
than in the reference files (edited on the pedal), not a decoding issue. *Observed.*

## Effect modules

A preset has 9 fixed slots. Each slot holds one model from that slot's catalog.

| Slot | Module | Models | D→H report | H→D set | `B4` focus id |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | FX/COMP | 12 | `02` | `82` | `06` (inferred) |
| 1 | DS/OD | 28 | `03` | `83` | `07` (inferred) |
| 2 | AMP | 75 | `04` | `84` | `08` (observed) |
| 3 | CAB | 46 | `05` | `85` | `09` (inferred) |
| 4 | NS GATE | 3 | `06` | `86` | `0A` (inferred) |
| 5 | EQ | 4 | `07` | `87` | `0B` (inferred) |
| 6 | MOD | 25 | `08` | `88` | `0C` (inferred) |
| 7 | DELAY | 9 | `09` | `89` | `0D` (observed) |
| 8 | REVERB | 8 | `0A` | `8A` | `0E` (observed) |

Module payload (24 bytes) = 12 × uint16 LE: `SWITCH (0/1), TYPE, p0 … p9`. Unused parameters are 0.

- `TYPE` is the **0-based** index into the slot's model list. The editor UI shows it 1-based
  ("07: YELLOW COMP" = TYPE 6). *Observed.*
- Parameter order and ranges come from the catalog the editor embeds as Qt resource
  `:/preset/preset/preset.xml`, extracted to `reference/model-catalog.en.xml` (Chinese:
  `.cn.xml`). A model without its own `<para>` list uses the list of the model at its `paraPos`
  (1-based index in the same chain). *Static, cross-checked against the dump.*
- `src/lib/catalog.json` is generated from that XML by `scripts/build-catalog.mjs`, with model
  descriptions from the manual (`reference/model-descriptions.json`, 147 of 210 models).
- Setting a module is real time and not persisted until `C3`. Knob drags send the whole slot
  state on every step (the editor sent 10 messages for one GAIN sweep). *Verified.*
- Turning a knob on the pedal sends the module report (`02`–`0A`) to the host. *Verified.*
- Changing the AMP model makes the device send a new CAB report (`05`): it auto-selects the
  matching cab. *Observed.*

### Parameter value encoding

Catalog specs look like `min_max_step_decimals_[unit]`, e.g. `0_100_1_0_`, `-12_12_0.1_1_`,
`40_2500_1_0_ ms`. Enumerations (`type="1"`) list option names separated by `_`, e.g.
`OFF_EL34_EL84_6L6_6V6`.

- Module parameters: `raw = (value − offset) / step` with `offset = min` only when the range goes
  negative; ranges starting at or above zero carry the value itself. *Verified* 2026-11-13 on the
  pedal's display (webcam): DELAY TIME (40–2500 ms) raw 1040 showed four digits and raw 960 showed
  "960", not 1000; EQ MOOER G 100Hz (−16…16) raw 4 showed −12 and raw 16 showed 0. PITCH raw 240 =
  +12.0 is consistent. `FREQ` 0–18000 starts at 0, so both readings agree.
- The **global EQ** is different: it offsets by `min` although its ranges are positive. *Verified*
  on the pedal display: LOW FREQ raw 9970 → 10000 Hz, HIGH FREQ raw 10895 → 10925 Hz, gains raw
  42/35/30 → 5 / 1.5 / −1 dB (0.5 dB steps around raw 32). Cut-filter units are still open (the
  page needs scrolling on the pedal).
- Enumerations carry the option index. *Verified* (DUAL DELAY SUB A raw 1 shown as 1/4).
- Value **positions** in the 10-value record follow the `<para>` order of the catalog, except for
  models with a fixed layout: CUSTOM EQ FREQ1/2/3 at 6/7/8; PHASER and STEP PHASER DEPTH at 3; PITCH
  SHIFT PITCH at 5; DETUNE PITCH at 4; DELAY DYNAMIC THRES at 6. Source:
  `reference/param-positions.json`, derived from all 200 dumps vs `.mo` files (*Observed*); PHASER,
  PITCH SHIFT and DYNAMIC also *Verified* on the pedal display (sent 11/22/33/44 → DEPTH 44; PITCH raw
  150 at position 5 → 3.0, MIX 61, TONE 72; THRES 77 at position 6). Where the editor keeps this table
  is not known; other models matched with list order.
- Module model numbers on the pedal are the 0-based type + 1 (MOD type 4 shown as "05:JET-FLANGER",
  DELAY type 8 as "09:DUAL DELAY", EQ type 0 as "01:MOOER G"). *Verified.*

### `.mo` preset files

The official editor's preset files are JSON (`reference/presets/` holds 201 examples).

```json
{
  "Exp": { "FUN_SWITCH": 1, "MODULE_CTRL": 6, "PARA_CTRL": 43, "VOL_MAX": 100, "VOL_MIN": 0, "VOL_SWITCH": 1 },
  "effectModule": { "0": { "Data": { "ATTACK": 25, "LEVEL": 60, "RATIO": 45, "THRES": 45 }, "SWITCH": 1, "TYPE": 6 }, "...": {} },
  "fileInfo": { "app": "GE150PRO Edit", "app_version": "V1.0.1", "device": "GE150PRO",
                "device_version": "V1.0.0", "preset_name": "Name", "schema": "GE150PRO Preset" }
}
```

`effectModule` keys `"0"`–`"8"` are slots; `Data` keys are catalog parameter names with raw values.
One library file uses an older schema with named keys (`"AMP"`, …); it is not supported.
Conversion: `src/lib/protocol/mo.ts`. Validation: `tools/validate_preset.py`.

## System settings

Take effect immediately; no store step. Ranges and labels are *Static* from `Setting::dataInit`,
`Setting::inputLevelInit`, `Setting::otgOutInit`, `Setting::screenInit`. Commands were captured
one control at a time (. A setting changed on the pedal itself is reported back with
the setter code minus `0x80`, the same rule as the effect modules. Conversely, when the host
sets a value, the pedal's display jumps to that setting's menu page, except for CAB L/R. *Observed.* All values uint16 LE.

| Cmd | Dir | Payload | Meaning | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `32` | D→H | `INPUT, BRIGHTNESS, CAB_L, CAB_R, OTG, LANGUAGE` | system state at connect | Verified (values match the editor UI) |
| `A4` | H→D | `INPUT` | input level index | Verified |
| `A5` | H→D | `BRIGHTNESS` | 0–20 | Verified |
| `A6` | H→D | `CAB_L, CAB_R` | CAB SIM THRU on left/right outputs, always both | Verified |
| `A7` | H→D | `OTG` | OTG (USB audio) level index | Verified |
| `A8` | H→D | `LANGUAGE` | pedal display language, 0 = Chinese, 1 = English | Verified |
| `11` | D→H | 9 values, layout of `D1` | global EQ at connect | Observed |
| `D1` | H→D | `ON, LOW FREQ, LOW GAIN, MID FREQ, MID GAIN, HIGH FREQ, HIGH GAIN, LOW CUT, HIGH CUT` | global EQ, whole struct per change | Verified |
| `12` | D→H | `SPILL` | spill-over at connect | Observed |
| `D2` | H→D | `SPILL` | spill-over on/off | Verified |
| `24` | D→H | `INPUT` | input level changed with the pedal's own knob; one message per click (10→9→8 seen) | Verified 2026-11-13 (UI follows the knob) |
| `25`, `27`, `28` | D→H | same as `A5`, `A7`, `A8` | brightness, OTG level, language changed on the pedal | Verified 2026-11-13 (UI follows) |
| `26` | D→H | same as `A6` | CAB outs changed on the pedal (SYSTEM menu) | Verified 2026-11-13 (UI follows) |
| `51` / `52` | D→H | same as `D1` / `D2` | global EQ (every field) / spill-over changed on the pedal | Verified 2026-11-13 (UI follows) |
| `C4` | H→D | `01` | sent when BACKUP is clicked; device answers `44 00 00`. The backup file itself is written from data the editor already holds. | Observed |

Level index → label (input and OTG): 0 `-∞`, 1 `-60`, 2 `-45`, 3 `-35`, 4 `-30`, 5 `-25`,
6 `-20`, 7 `-10`, 8 `-5`, 9 `0 dB`, then +0.5 dB per step up to 21 = `6.0 dB`. *Static.*

Global EQ ranges, raw = (value − min) / step: FREQ 30–18000 Hz step 1; GAIN −16…+16 dB step 0.5
(raw 32 = 0 dB); LOW CUT 0–800 step 1; HIGH CUT 0–19001 step 1. *Static.* Raw 0 displays OFF for
both cut filters. *Observed in the UI.* Whether non-zero cut values are Hz is *Unknown*.

## Rhythm (drum machine)

The drum machine is controlled only on the pedal (RHYTHM button, RHYTHM menu, TAP). The pedal reports
every change; the editor only displays it. The manual describes the editor's area as one to "view Drum
Machine information".

| Cmd | Dir | Payload | Meaning | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `8C` | H→D | `01` | request rhythm state (`RequestRhythmData`) | Static, Observed at connect |
| `0C` | D→H | `ON, MODE, STYLE, VOL` (u8 each), `BPM` (u16 LE) | ON 0/1; MODE 0 = RHYTHM, 1 = METRONOME; STYLE 0-based; BPM 40–260 (manual) | Observed 2026-11-13 ( on/off, style ×3, BPM ×3, VOL ×3, mode toggled) |

Each mode keeps its own STYLE and BPM: switching to METRONOME reported style 0 / 120 BPM, switching back
restored style 3 / 123 BPM. VOL is shared. *Observed.* Style counts: 40 rhythms, 10 metronome patterns
(manual). Style names are in the firmware's menu strings (`GE150PRO_V2.1.2.mr` at 0x47f12): 40 rhythm
styles from "8 BEAT 1" to "TANGO", 10 metronome patterns "METRO", "METRO 2/4" … "METRO 9/8"
(`RHYTHM_STYLES`, `METRONOME_STYLES` in `rhythm.ts`). Style 3 = "8 BEAT 4" matches the pedal's display. *Verified.*

No host→device rhythm setter exists in the editor: `SetRhythmModulePara` is only called from the
receive path (`usbReceiveThread::DealData`), and `Core::setBpm` only sets a label. The editor's only
writes are the `Request*` functions and the generic `SendHidCmd`; none of their callers touch rhythm.
*Static.*

Probe, 2026-11-13, with the pedal owner's consent: `8C 00 00 03 08 7C 00` (current state, BPM 123→124).
The pedal answered with an unchanged `0C … 7B 00` (BPM 123) and nothing else changed: `8C` is a
request whatever its payload, not a setter. *Observed.* No other setter candidate has evidence, so no
further probing was done.

## Firmware analysis (static, nothing flashed)

`.mr` layout: a 0x280-byte header (`Mooer_TAGGE150PRO`), then an unencrypted STM32 (Cortex-M, Thumb-2)
application linked at 0x08004000 (vector table at file offset 0x280, initial SP 0x2000f3a0, reset
0x080042b9). Menu strings are plain text (rhythm style names at 0x47f12). *Static.*

The host-command dispatcher is at 0x08085fde in both versions and handles the same 36 codes:
`00 82–8C 96 97 98 A0 A4–A8 B0 B3 B4 B5 BA BB C1 C3 C4 C5 D1–D5` (`31` is handled elsewhere, during the
connect sequence only). Handlers store the payload and post an event to another task through
`0x08091070`; `r1 = 2` there means "send report `r3`" (`8C` → `0C`, `C4` → `44`). Codes the editor never
sends:

| Code | What the handler does | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `8B` | erases flash sectors (0x102000, 0x104000, …) through `0x080a2154`, then event `C5` | **destructive** (factory reset / data wipe); never send |
| `BA` | sets a busy flag and erases the same flash sectors, event `C3` | **destructive** (update start); never send |
| `BB` | clears that flag, event `C4` | end of an update; never send |
| `B5` | passes the payload to a data-import routine (`0x0809deb8`) | import, not investigated |
| `C5` | request, answered with report `45` | read-only, purpose unknown |
| `D3`, `D4` | chunked upload: 512-byte blocks into one of 21 slots, then written to flash | IR / amp-capture import (gap 4) |
| `D5` | request for slot n (n < 21), answered with report `15` | IR slot info |

None of them writes the rhythm state, so **neither V2.1.2 nor V2.1.4 accepts rhythm control over USB**;
the drum machine is controlled only by the pedal's own buttons. *Static*, consistent with the probe of
`8C` with a payload and the MIDI tests.

## USB-MIDI interface

The pedal has an undocumented USB-MIDI function: USB interface 3 (Audio Control) and interface 4 (MIDI
Streaming, class 1 subclass 3); macOS lists a MIDI source and destination named "GE150Pro". *Observed.*
The manual does not mention MIDI and retailers list "MIDI: No" (no DIN sockets). The official editor
does not use MIDI (no CoreMIDI linkage or MIDI strings). *Static.*

Tests on 2026-11-13, firmware V2.1.2, with the pedal owner's consent (standard real-time messages only):

| Test | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Listen while the drum machine plays, presets and pages change | nothing received (no clock, no start/stop, no program or control changes) | Observed, several minutes |
| MIDI Stop (`FC`) while the drum machine plays | ignored: RHYTHM LED stays lit, no `0C` report | Observed (webcam + HID) |
| MIDI Clock (`F8`) at 100 BPM for 6 s | ignored: `8C` request afterwards reports 123 BPM | Observed |

Not tested: Start/Continue (`FA`/`FB`) while stopped; program and control changes (a program change
would switch presets; no control-change map is known, so CC numbers would be guesses). Open: what the
MIDI function is for (possibly unused, or reserved for a later firmware).

## Expression pedal

Per-preset settings, stored in the preset tail (`EXP_ORDER`) and changed live like module edits
(store with `C3` to keep). The host setter is the report code + `0x80`. All values uint16 LE.

| Cmd | Dir | Payload | Meaning | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `98` / `18` | H→D / D→H | `MODULE_CTRL, PARA_CTRL, FUN_SWITCH` | what the pedal controls (pedal menu EXP → FUNCTION) | Verified H→D 2026-11-13 (web EXP panel, pedal follows); D→H Observed at connect |
| `B3` / `33` | H→D / D→H | `VOL_SWITCH, VOL_MIN, VOL_MAX` | volume-pedal mode (pedal menu EXP → EXP VOL) | Verified H→D 2026-11-13 (switch, MIN, MAX from the web panel, pedal follows); D→H Observed at connect |

`18` and `33` arrive at connect and after `16` (preset changed on the pedal). Whether the pedal also
sends them when EXP is changed in its own menu is *Inferred* (same pattern as `24`–`28`).
`MODULE_CTRL` is the chain slot 0–8 (FX … REV). The editor selects a module's first parameter when
switching modules.

`PARA_CTRL` ids come from `Exp::dataInit`, which lists each module's name and parameter names with
literal ids. *Static.* The first id of every module (0, 10, 13, 19, 21, 25, 39, 51, 57) matches the
`98` messages captured from the editor. *Observed.* The ids are global, not per model; the editor shows the same
list for every model of a module. Ids above 100 are *Verified* on the pedal's EXP → FUNCTION page:
MOD 101 shows "DELAY", REV 109 shows "SHIMMER". The pedal labels 57 "PRE DELAY" (editor: P.DELAY).

| Module | `PARA_CTRL` = name |
|---|---|
| 0 FX | 0 POSITION, 1 Q, 2 RATE, 3 ATTACK, 4 RANGE, 5 SENS, 6 THRES, 7 PEAK, 8 RATIO, 9 LEVEL, 100 DEPTH |
| 1 DS | 10 VOLUME, 11 TONE, 12 GAIN |
| 2 AMP | 13 GAIN, 14 BASS, 15 MID, 16 TREBLE, 17 PRES, 18 MST |
| 3 CAB | 19 CENTER, 20 DISTANCE |
| 4 NS | 21 THRES, 22 SENS, 23 ATTACK, 24 RELEASE |
| 5 EQ | 25 80HZ, 26 100HZ, 27 200HZ, 28 240HZ, 29 250HZ, 30 400HZ, 31 630HZ, 32 750HZ, 33 800HZ, 34 1.6KHZ, 35 2.2KHZ, 36 3.2KHZ, 37 4KHZ, 38 6.6KHZ |
| 6 MOD | 39 RATE, 40 PITCH, 41 RISE, 42 SAMPLE, 43 MIX, 44 DEPTH, 45 LEVEL, 46 F.BACK, 47 TONE, 48 Q, 49 RANGE, 50 BIT, 101 DELAY, 102 SPEED, 103 INTENSITY, 104 SUB, 105 SUB TONE, 106 UPPER, 107 UPPER TONE, 108 DRY |
| 7 DLY | 51 LEVEL, 52 F.BACK, 53 TIME, 54 TIME A, 55 THRES, 56 TIME B |
| 8 REV | 57 P.DELAY, 58 LEVEL, 59 DECAY, 60 TONE, 109 SHIMMER |

Moving a connected expression pedal produces the normal module report of the controlled module
(`02`–`0A`) at about 30 ms intervals; there is no separate EXP value message. *Observed* (
AMP GAIN and REV). An earlier note that the editor printed "EXP:FX - POSITION" for 6 / 43 (MOD MIX by
this table) was most likely the label's default before data arrived. *Inferred.*

VOL_MIN/VOL_MAX range 0–100 is *Inferred* from the connect value. The pedal accepts VOL_MIN above
VOL_MAX unchanged (MIN 80 / MAX 20 shown as sent; *Verified*, webcam), so the UI does not clamp.
CALIBRATE exists only on the pedal.

The pedal has two modes, toggled by the toe switch (firm press at full toe-down): Expression (EXP
LED lit, the pedal moves `PARA_CTRL`) and Volume (EXP LED dark, master volume between VOL_MIN and
VOL_MAX). *Manual.* In Expression mode the pedal swept REV P.DELAY over raw 68–252 of 0–500 on the
test unit, possibly because the pedal is uncalibrated. *Observed.* Open: whether the pedal reports a
toe-switch mode change, and whether it sends anything when moved in Volume mode. On 2026-11-13 the toe
switch did not trigger (EXP LED stayed lit, only `0A` reports arrived); retry after CALIBRATE.

## UI focus ids (`B4` / `34`)

The editor sends `B4 <id>` when the user opens a page or control; the device echoes `34 <id>`. The
device also sends `34` on its own when its screen changes page. Writes work without sending `B4`
(the web app never sends it). *Verified.*

| id | Pedal page | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `01` | EXP menu (FUNCTION / CALIBRATE / EXP VOL) | Verified (webcam) |
| `02` | RHYTHM menu | Verified (webcam) |
| `04` | SYSTEM menu | Verified (webcam) |
| `05` | store/save dialog | Observed (editor sends it before `C3`) |
| `06`–`0E` | effect pages, slot + 6 (`06` FX, `07` DS, … `0E` REV) | Verified for 06, 07, 0E (webcam); 08, 0D Observed |
| `0F` | EXP → FUNCTION | Verified (webcam) |
| `10` | EXP → CALIBRATE | Verified (webcam) |
| `11` | SYSTEM → INPUT LEVEL | Verified (webcam) |
| `13` | LOOPER | Verified (webcam) |
| `14` | SYSTEM → CAB SIM THRU | Observed |
| `15` | **SYSTEM → RESET** (NO/YES prompt, shows firmware VERSION) | Verified (webcam). **Never send.** |
| `16` | EXP → EXP VOL | Verified (webcam) |
| `17` | SYSTEM → SCREEN (brightness) | Observed |
| `18` | SYSTEM → OTG LEVEL | Observed |
| `19` | SYSTEM → LANGUAGE | Observed |
| `1B` | bank browser (four presets of a bank) | Verified (webcam) |
| `1D` | SYSTEM → GLOBAL EQ | Verified (webcam) |
| `1E` | SYSTEM → SPILL-OVER | Observed |

`B4` only moves the pedal's screen; it changes no setting. *Verified* (2026-11-13, webcam, no `16`
or other reports followed). `10`, `13` and `15` were sent without prior observation, which broke the
probing rules; `15` opened the factory-reset prompt (cursor on NO, nothing confirmed). Do not send
unobserved `B4` ids, and never `15`. The pedal's firmware is V2.1.2 (RESET page).

## Gaps

Ordered by value for the web app. "How" names the cheapest method (described in the original).

| # | Gap | Why it matters | How |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Rhythm *control* from the host: **not supported by the firmware** (dispatcher analysis, V2.1.2 and V2.1.4); USB-MIDI Stop and Clock are ignored too. The official editor cannot do it (read-only, *Static*); reports are fully decoded; `8C` with a full payload is only a request (*Observed* probe) | play/stop, style, BPM, VOL from the web UI | Probably not supported by the firmware. Only a firmware analysis or a newer official editor could show a setter. Style names: solved (firmware strings) |
| 2 | EXP: whether the pedal echoes changes made in its own EXP menu, and toe-switch mode reports | UI following the pedal; mode-aware EXP readout | Change MIN/MAX in the editor's EXP panel during a capture; change EXP on the pedal while the web app is connected |
| 3 | Restore from backup (RECALL) and the official `.backup` format (`MOOER` header, `BUFF` segments, `BackupFile::*` checksums) | Retire the official app completely | Disassemble `BackupFile::WriteFileHead`, `GetFileHeadCheckNum`, `GetDataSegmentCheckNum`; capture RECALL **only** with a disposable backup |
| 4 | IR import (`usbSendThread::ImportIrData`, `CWavFile`), amp capture/NAM import (`ImportAmpData`, `AMPForGNR`), delete (`DeleteIrOrAmpData`) | User IRs in CAB slots 27–36 | Capture an IR import; expect bulk transfers (the logger already hooks `libusb_bulk_transfer`) |
| 7 | Global EQ LOW CUT / HIGH CUT units for non-zero values | Display only | Step each once in the editor and note the label |
| 8 | `4D` (40 zero bytes, sent with every `41` answer to `C1`), `C4`/`44` purpose | Completeness | Static: `usbReceiveThread::AnalysisData` / `DealData` dispatch on the command byte |
| 9 | Firmware update (`GE150PROUpdate`, `Firmware/GE150PRO_V2.1.2.mr`) | Out of scope for now; risky | Do not attempt without an explicit decision |
| 10 | RESET (factory reset) command | Deliberately not implemented | Do not send |

## Safety

The game sends only commands observed from Mooer's editor. It never sends factory reset, firmware, `8B` or `BA`
(they erase flash), never tries unknown command bytes or arguments (`B4 15` opens the reset prompt), and asks before
writing a preset slot (`C3`).
